messages:
alice: Starting a micro-shard cutover now — this is a small fanout (5%) to test v2.4.0. Change window still OK. deploy-bot: [deploy] initiating canary: service=edge-fanout shard=shard-7 from v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (5% sample) — started 1743219999 :rocket:
ben: Thanks. Observability please: can we get splits for 200ms+ tail, 5xx rate, and embedding QPS?
carla: Watching logs and p99. So far no obvious errors, a couple of 429s on a single host. Not widespread.
sre_oncall: Seeing a small increase in internal queueing on shard-7, CPU ~78% on the affected pod. Not yet breaching our throttle rule.
alice: Note: new routing uses fallback-to-v2.3.1 for >2s latency. If we see >0.5% 5xx or sustained p95 bump, we should either pin back or abort.
ben: Quick sanity check — what exact rollback command if we abort? carla: `deploy-bot rollback --service edge-fanout --to v2.3.1 --shards shard-7` (one-line).
alice: If we abort, we want a soft-pin to v2.3.1 for 15m then monitor before fully unpinning.
deploy-bot: [metrics] canary telemetry: p95 latency +12% (baseline 210ms -> 235ms), 5xx=0.12%, 429=0.6% at 60s after start.
carla: 429s concentrated on a single AZ host, looks like a downstream throttling surge. Not a code regression yet.
ben: Agree. Proposed: hold at 5% for another 10m, split traffic across AZs to verify it's AZ noisy. Anyone object? :thinking:
carla: No objection. I'll open a quick infra ticket to rebalance if it persists.
sre_oncall: FYI I can trigger AZ redispatch but prefer we observe for 5-10 more minutes. CPU trending up though.
alice: Vote check — stay (continue 5%) or stop (rollback & pin)? Please reply with 'stay' or 'stop'.
ben: stay
carla: stay (but ready to stop if 5xx > 0.5% or 429 > 1% sustained)
sre_oncall: stay, but will flip to stop if CPU > 85% or queue latency spike > 100ms for 3m
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary ramp paused at 5% per manual hold flag by alice (auto-ramp disabled).
carla: Rebalancer kicked — spreading canary pods to two other AZs, watch now.
deploy-bot: [metrics] 3m snapshot after rebalance: p95 back to +6%, 5xx=0.05%, 429=0.2%.
alice: Good signal. Plan: continue at 5% for 20m, then 20% if no regressions. No pin now. I'll post release-note snippet after 20m if stable.
ben: Sounds good. Will monitor SLO dashboards and echo if anything degrades.
carla: Also noting small schema NACKs in logs — not related to runtime but will track.
sre_oncall: Oncall: I'll mark channel and be ready to run the rollback command if we hit thresholds.
alice: Thanks all. If anyone wants to abort, say 'stop' now, otherwise we hold and proceed per plan.
ben: all clear from me
carla: clear
deploy-bot: [audit] manual hold set by alice at 1743220050
alice: Closing decision: stay. We'll reconvene at 1743220119 for the next checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
